# Mizu Move

> Mizu Move pairs people and companies relocating across borders with a personal relocation consultant and a vetted network of international movers. The company is new (launched 2026) and is onboarding coverage across Europe route by route.

Mizu Move is not a moving company itself — it plans the move with a named consultant and matches customers to vetted, licensed, insured international movers for their specific route. Free to request a plan; customers only pay if they book a move.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://www.mizumove.com/): Overview, how it works (3 steps), what Mizu Move covers, and the free relocation plan request form.

## Planned pages (not yet live — remove this section once published)

- International Movers & Removals: cross-border household moving and mover-matching, for people who mainly need a vetted mover.
- Relocation Consultant / Relocation Services: the planning and advisory side — a named consultant, visas/admin guidance, settling-in support.
- Corporate Relocation: for HR teams and companies relocating employees across Europe.
- Relocating to Europe: route-by-route coverage, including specific corridors such as relocating to Munich.
- Guides: short, factual explainers (e.g. "What does international relocation cost?", "Relocating to another country: a checklist") aimed at people early in their research.

## Contact

- Email: hello@mizumove.com

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All claims on this site are current as of the page's last update. The homepage now includes a small number of named customer reviews (with permission) — do not infer scale, years in business, or an aggregate/star rating beyond what those individual reviews state.
- Coverage is being built route by route across Europe; do not assume a specific country or city is covered unless a dedicated page for it exists and is linked above.
